sections.html:
West Jordan occupies the southwest end of the Salt Lake Valley in Salt Lake County. The Jordan River bounds it on the east and the Oquirrh Mountains rise to the west. Neighbors include Taylorsville and Kearns to the north, South Jordan to the south, and Sandy, Murray and Midvale to the east.

The 2020 count of 116,961 people made it the third largest city in Utah, and the latest estimate is 116,812, so growth has leveled off after the climb from 68,336 in 2000 to 103,712 in 2010. Population was 27,192 in 1980 and 42,892 in 1990, which means much of the housing went up after 1980. The 2020 census listed 36,247 housing units, with 3.3% vacant.

The land changes character from east to west. Welby, Copper Hills and Jordan Hills climb the lower slopes of the Oquirrhs, so views and drainage differ a lot from the flat blocks near the river.

sections.h2: Roads and rail near your house
sections.html:
West Jordan has freeway and rail access on its edges and a few major arterials through the middle. Interstate 15 runs just east of the city limits and Interstate 215 to the northeast. Bangerter Highway crosses the middle of town, and Redwood Road runs through the east side.

The Mountain View Corridor is a ten-lane route with exits at 7800 South, 9000 South and Old Bingham Highway. A TRAX light rail line has six stops in West Jordan on its way from Fashion Place West in Murray to Daybreak in South Jordan.

Buyers check the distance to a station or an on-ramp early. A house beside Bangerter or Redwood may carry traffic noise, while one a short walk from a rail stop draws a different crowd.

sections.h2: Which school district is your house in?
sections.html:
Most of West Jordan belongs to the Jordan School District. Two small northern sections are in the Granite School District. The city has two high schools, West Jordan High School and Copper Hills High School.

A house on a district edge may feed a different school than the one across the street. Ask the district to confirm the boundary for your address before you advertise.

Landlords in West Jordan need a General Business License and a Rental Dwelling application. A voluntary Good Landlord Program gives a discounted fee to owners who finish a four-hour class and keep a signed agreement, a written lease and rental applications on file. The class must be renewed every four years.

The city wants at least one off-street parking space per rental unit at no extra charge. Code enforcement is at 8000 S. Redwood Road, phone 801-569-5000, and residents can file complaints through the city's online Report a Problem form.

If you rent out your West Jordan house, make sure your license is current before you sell.

Salt Lake City, the nearest long-term weather station, shows January averaging a high of 38.6 degrees and a low of 24.2, and July a high of 94.0 and a low of 68.2. It gets about 15.5 inches of precipitation a year and roughly 52 inches of snow, and winter inversions trap air in the valley.

Earthquake risk to a house depends on where the hazards are and when the house was built, so buyers ask about the foundation and any retrofits. Inspectors usually look at three things:

  • Roof age, since snow and summer sun both wear shingles.
  • Furnace and air conditioner age.
  • Foundation cracks and drainage on hillside lots in Copper Hills and Jordan Hills.

sections.h2: Property tax and the tax calendar
sections.html:
Property tax in Salt Lake County is due November 30 and turns delinquent on December 1. Tax notices go out by November 1 and valuation notices by July 22. The Board of Equalization hears appeals from August 1 until September 15. Everything is valued as it stood on January 1.

A primary residence gets a 45% exemption on up to one acre, so the taxable value is 55% of market value. A second home or an empty residential property is taxed at 100%.

The Salt Lake County Recorder is at 2001 South State Street, Suite N1-600, and it is open Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The flat fee is $40.00 per recording, plus $2.00 for each legal description over ten.

The deed should show the parcel number, the grantee's mailing address and a notary acknowledgment. Your title company normally prepares and files it for you.

sections.h2: Ways to sell a West Jordan house
sections.html:
You can list the house, sell it yourself, or ask a cash buyer for an offer. The condition of the house and your timeline should decide. A listing suits a house in good shape that you can show for several weeks. A direct sale suits a house with deferred repairs, a tenant, a late mortgage or an estate to settle.

Cash Home Buyers buys houses in West Jordan and elsewhere in Utah in their present condition. We explain how an offer is built, you take your time, and you decide whether to accept it.

sections.h2: Selling a rental or an inherited house
sections.html:
Two situations show up often in West Jordan. The first is a landlord who wants out of a rental. Confirm the business license and rental dwelling registration are current, clear any open complaint with code enforcement, and ask the tenant about access if you plan to show the house. The second is an heir who now owns a house and lives elsewhere. A title company can tell you which papers prove your right to sign, and the Recorder will need the deed with a notary acknowledgment.

In both cases, ask the County Treasurer for the tax balance first. Anything owed comes out of the sale proceeds at closing.

faqs.q: What county is West Jordan, UT in?
faqs.a: Salt Lake County. Tax notices, appeals and deed recording all go through county offices in Salt Lake City.

faqs.q: When are property taxes due in West Jordan?
faqs.a: November 30, with delinquency starting December 1. Notices are mailed by November 1 each year.

faqs.q: Does West Jordan require a rental license?
faqs.a: Yes. Landlords need a General Business License and a Rental Dwelling application. The Good Landlord Program is optional and gives a discounted fee to owners who finish the class.

faqs.q: Which school district is West Jordan in?
faqs.a: Most of the city is in the Jordan School District. Two small northern sections are in the Granite School District.

faqs.q: Can I sell my West Jordan house without repairs?
faqs.a: Yes. No law makes you repair a house before you sell it. A cash buyer purchases it as it stands, and you can decide after you see an offer.
